name: Make-A-Wish Malaysia
summary: Grants wishes for children with critical, life-threatening illnesses, working with hospitals across Peninsular and East Malaysia.
programmes: Wish granting for critically ill children
Hospital partnerships in Peninsular and East Malaysia
Fundraising events, volunteering and corporate partnerships
impact: 100+ wishes granted each year; 1,200+ since 2010 (The Star, 6 Aug 2026)
beneficiaries: Children with critical or life-threatening medical conditions and their families

organisation.leadership: Y.A.M. Tengku Datin Paduka Setia Zatashah Binti Sultan Sharafuddin Idris Shah (Royal Patron); Datuk Stuart Ramalingam (Chairman); Dato' Sri Dr Nick Low (Vice Chairman); Mahesh Ramesh (Treasurer); Sammy Chan (Secretary); Irene Tan (Chief Executive Officer)
